LanguageData.APM_Gun_Pulse_Shotgun.label: Charge Scattershot
LanguageData.APM_Gun_Pulse_Shotgun.description: Close quarters combat with mechanized foes is never a good idea, and the introduction of the charge scattershot turns that idea into a death wish. This shotgun uses pulse munitions and the result is a prime emplacement breaching tool. Enemy forces are typically less armored than defense emplacements and even a militor could determine the results of that matchup.
